snippet.title: Airplane Tires Survive Extreme Landing Friction ✈️🔥
snippet.description:
Commercial aircraft tires face an immediate transition from absolute standstill to speeds of 155 miles per hour upon runway contact. This generates sudden friction and smoke upon touchdown.

A single wheel assembly is engineered to withstand nearly 40,000 pounds of direct pressure. The structure relies on specialized layers of high-strength materials designed specifically for impact absorption.

Temperature tolerance is a critical survival factor for these aviation components. They maintain strict structural integrity in heat ranging from 194 to 392 degrees Fahrenheit without melting or failing.

This level of absolute reliability requires a significant financial investment from operating airlines. A single new replacement costs approximately $7,000, bringing the total for a heavy Airbus A380 to well over $100,000.

snippet.title: 9 killed in mass shooting at a home in Erie, Pennsylvania
snippet.description:
A mass shooting at a home in Erie left nine people dead, including two children and the gunman, in an incident local law enforcement described as the most devastating in the city's history. Police responded to a residence in the 700 block of Perry Street around 4:50 p.m. Friday after a automated gunshot detection alert. Witnesses reported seeing a man firing a handgun on the sidewalk, where two women were killed, before he ran inside the home. Tactical teams secured the area and later discovered six more victims and the suspect dead inside. Investigators determined that all the victims had died before officers arrived and that the unidentified shooter died of an apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound. Erie Police Chief Rick Lorah said there is no ongoing threat to the public, while Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro pledged the state's full support to Erie Mayor Daria Devlin as the investigation continues.

snippet.title: Uma Ilha REBROTOU Sozinha 300 Anos Depois
snippet.description:
Em 1700, Edmond Halley soltou algumas cabras numa ilha deserta a 1.160 km da costa do Espírito Santo. A ideia era deixar comida para náufragos. Náufrago nenhum apareceu.

Em 300 anos, a Ilha da Trindade perdeu a floresta, de 1 a 2 metros de solo, nascentes e uma cachoeira. A árvore que cobria 85% da ilha foi extinta ali, e a fragata-de-trindade chegou a 30 indivíduos.

Em 2005, os últimos caprinos foram retirados. Ninguém plantou nada. Imagens de satélite de 1994 a 2024 mostram que a floresta cresceu 1.468%, que espécies endêmicas com menos de 10 indivíduos hoje somam cerca de 100 e que a cachoeira voltou a correr.

Halley acertou o cometa porque órbita é previsível. Errou a ilha porque um rebanho solto não é.

📊 Meu nome é Ozzy e eu mostro a beleza escondida nos dados todos os dias. Se inscreva para não perder a próxima história.

The Supreme Court has heard a petition concerning the protests and ordered the restoration of internet and metro services. Meanwhile, Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das have been released by the court after being detained over the October 10 protests. Meanwhile, India rebukes the UNHRC for raising concerns over protest detentions.
In this video, Firstpost tracks the latest developments as protesters demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

KP Under Emergency and Governor’s Rule | President Issues Official Notification


Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has contacted Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman to discuss the ongoing political deadlock, PTI’s long march, and the possibility of resolving tensions through negotiations, according to sources.

Sources say the telephone conversation took place after the prime minister’s consultative meeting. Maulana Fazlur Rehman reportedly offered to play a role in resolving the situation through mutual understanding and advised the government to avoid imposing an emergency or Governor’s Rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, warning that such measures could cause political damage to the ruling parties.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif reiterated that the government remains willing to negotiate but said PTI should end its long march and return to the negotiating table. He maintained that a long march towards Islamabad and negotiations cannot proceed simultaneously.

According to sources, the prime minister said the federal government had made sincere efforts to resolve issues through dialogue. He also cited the KP government’s reported refusal to cooperate on counterterrorism measures as a reason for the failure of negotiations, stressing that there could be no compromise on the fight against terrorism.

Maulana Fazlur Rehman reportedly assured the prime minister that he would play a role in reducing political tensions and continue backchannel contacts with the parties for the time being.
